guia_conteudo.termos_texto:
By using Injectables Control, the user declares to be fully aware that:

1. The user assumes TOTAL and exclusive responsibility for the doses, mixtures (Mix), and protocols generated.
2. CodeVibe Studio is NOT responsible for filling errors or miscalculations generated by incorrect data.
3. The "Biomarker Check-up" and "Cycle Simulator" are purely mathematical estimates aimed at harm reduction. They DO NOT have the value of medical prescription or advice.
4. The user exempts the creators from any clinical complication arising from the use of this logistical tool.
guia_conteudo.aviso_texto:
This application is exclusively a logistical and mathematical support tool. IT DOES NOT REPLACE MEDICAL ADVICE.

• The app does not prescribe or recommend treatments.
• In case of extreme pain, fever, intense redness, swelling, shortness of breath, or any discomfort after an injection, SEEK AN EMERGENCY ROOM IMMEDIATAMENTE or contact your doctor.
• Never start or change dosages without the knowledge and authorization of your healthcare professional.
guia_conteudo.higiene_texto:
Lack of hygiene can cause serious infections and abscesses. Strictly follow:

• Wash hands with soap and water before touching materials.
• Clean the vial rubber with cotton and 70% Alcohol.
• Cleanse the skin with 70% Alcohol and let it air dry before puncturing.
• Use ONLY sterile, single-use (disposable) syringes and needles.
• Dispose of sharps in a suitable rigid container.
guia_conteudo.como_usar_texto:
• Medication Database: Management hub. Register your vials and dosages.

• Smart Calculators: Access the Central Calculator (Syringe Icon). Use the "Reconstitution Assistant" to calculate the dilution of Lyophilized Powders (Peptides/GH) using Bacteriostatic Water, or the Label Calculator directly in the form.

• Cycle Simulator: New interactive tool. Plots a daily blood release graph calculating half-life, Superposition Principle (accumulation), and ester weight.

• Safe Mix: Group compounds in the same syringe. The app sums final volumes safely.

• Smart Schedule: The engine deflects collisions at the same site. It has a safety lock that forces you to complete the current pending injection before advancing to future dates.
guia_conteudo.cerebro_texto:
The app features a predictive safety engine:

• Biometric Profile: Cross-references your age, weight, and biological sex with treatment pharmacology to suggest exact blood panels.

• Pre-Exam Protocol: Before collection, the system imposes a strict Clinical Checklist (Fasting, Training Pause, Pelvic Rest, etc.) to avoid false positives.

• Biomarker Alert: The first ideal window ("steady state") is suggested 45 days after starting a new treatment. Maintenances follow every 120 days.
guia_conteudo.notificacoes_texto:
To ensure maximum performance and save battery, our engine adopts a silent architecture:

• Anti-Spam Queue: Recent devices block alarm abuse (500/app limit). Therefore, the app schedules only the next 60 injections at the system root.

• Auto-replenishment: As you apply your doses and "Check" in the app, the queue moves, and future injections are scheduled automatically in the background.
guia_conteudo.seringas_subtitulo: Understand the proper material for each application:
guia_conteudo.seringas_texto2:
• Subcutaneous (SC - Fat): Short and thin needles, e.g., 13x0.45mm or 13x0.3mm (brown/gray). Applied at a 90° or 45° angle depending on adipose tissue.
• Intramuscular (IM - Muscle): Long needles to reach the muscle, e.g., 25x0.7mm or 30x0.7mm (black/blue) and for larger volumes 25x0.8mm (green). Apply at a 90° angle.
guia_conteudo.seringas_texto4:
• Insulin Syringes (100 IU = 1 mL): Detailed scale. 10 IU equals 0.1 mL. Ideal for highly precise subcutaneous microdoses.
• 3 mL or 5 mL Syringes: Used for intramuscular applications requiring a larger volume of diluent or oil.
guia_conteudo.mapas_alerta_texto:
✅ The Ventrogluteal is now considered the gold standard and safest site for intramuscular injections, being completely free of large vessels and nerves.

❌ The old "Dorsogluteal" (upper outer quadrant) is being abandoned in current clinical practice. It poses a high risk of sciatic nerve injury and has more risks than benefits.

exames.checklist_subtitulo: Confirm the rules below to avoid false positives in your hormonal results.
exames.item1_desc: Mandatory for Basal Insulin and Glycemia. Max 14h. Drink plenty of water, it's allowed!
exames.item2_desc: Suspend weightlifting. Micro-lesions falsely elevate CPK, Creatinine, and AST.
exames.item3_desc: No ejaculation (avoids false Prolactin and PSA peaks). Do not ride motorcycles or bicycles.
exames.item4_desc: Zero alcohol to avoid acute peaks in GGT, Triglycerides, and systemic inflammation.
exames.item5_desc: Strict collection between 07h and 09h AM to catch Testosterone, TSH, and Prolactin at their basal peak.
exames.item6_desc: Do not pause or delay injections in the app. The exam must reflect real hormonal kinetics.
